title: Consolidate persisted scalar admission into one sequence owner

research_basis.decision: GPU-23 retained a bounded paired same-process effect-size gate showing that the already semantically proved sequence-level admission candidate had the lower scalar-admission microstage median in all six Boolean fixtures. That evidence nominated exactly one minimal in-place production consolidation trial, without establishing constructor-wide acceleration.

implementation.production_change: Delete the per-entry relation_blocks._stored helper and make relation_blocks._stored_values the single persisted-scalar admission owner for one bounded relation-block value sequence. TypedRelationBlock.__post_init__ resolves the persisted semiring once, admits the bounded value sequence once, and then performs the existing CSR validation path.
implementation.gardening: The old per-entry helper is deleted rather than retained beside the sequence owner. No cache, registry, trusted constructor, backend, relation type, alternate validator, workflow path, or second benchmark harness was added.

canonicalization_contract.boolean: exact bool, semiring zero refused, existing tuple retained
canonicalization_contract.natural: exact non-negative bounded int, semiring zero refused, existing tuple retained
canonicalization_contract.tropical: numeric finite non-negative cost, float canonicalization retained, -0.0 canonicalized to +0.0
canonicalization_contract.evidence_dag: EvidenceValue with non-empty alternatives, existing tuple retained
canonicalization_contract.unsupported_semiring: same explicit refusal remains before scalar admission

focused_semantic_evidence.single_owner: Regression instrumentation pins exactly one _stored_values call for a canonical constructor and pins that relation_blocks._stored no longer exists.
focused_semantic_evidence.first_error_precedence: Focused cases pin the first invalid/zero scalar for Boolean, Natural, Tropical and EvidenceDag, including Natural bounded bit length.
focused_semantic_evidence.canonical_digest: Tropical negative zero is normalized to positive zero with identical canonical JSON and digest; existing tuple identity is retained for non-normalizing semirings.

post_change_diagnostic.interpretation: The production constructor now has one sequence-admission call rather than one helper call per stored entry. The timing values are post-change diagnostics only; cProfile contains observer overhead, and there is no same-run pre/post constructor A/B in GPU-24.

claim_boundary.allowed: GPU-24 establishes a single persisted-scalar admission owner with focused semantic, hash-seed, integrated-contract, wheel, collection and retained post-change diagnostic evidence.

next_narrow_step: If still before 2026-09-29, use the retained v8 constructor attribution to select one active end-to-end materialization cost or return to a higher-priority bounded Fourfold/Tensor issue; do not restore the deleted per-entry helper or add a parallel admission authority.
